name: tesla
description: Nikola Tesla Académie — plateforme pédagogique de la Communauté Nikola Tesla (Branche Route, Abidjan)

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @tesla/api" "npm run dev -w @tesla/web"
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @tesla/web
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:shared && npm run dev -w @tesla/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
